question: Related Questions Q. Please tell me the division of belongings (jewellery and land) of a deceased person among her brothers and sisters. 2475 views Q. Asalamualaykum Mufti Sahab, My father expired 11 years ago. My mother is alive and we in all are 3 sisters and 3 brothers. One brother is refusing to take any share in our fathers wealth. He says he does not want it. What do we do with it? Can he refuse it? 1691 views Q. Property inheritance 2737 views Q. sharing of property 1615 views Q. A lady had died leaving behind only daughter,daughter is married and has 3 daughter and 3 sons, rest of her family i.e her brother and sister all are dead and they all died before she did,thou the children of her brother and sister are there. Do they have a right in her wealth? Do her grand children have any right in the wealth or it all belongs to the daughter? 1782 views Q. We are 4 sisters and 1 brother.Father died in 1983 leaving behind a house.From the beginning I have been living on the ground floor firstly with my parents then with my mother and sisters and since 2003 only with my own family.Elder sister built with her money(Rs350000)1st floor in 88 and started living there.Mother died in 99.Now 3 younger sisters who are residing in rented houses are demanding share.Elder sister says from the sale price she first be paid current value of 1st floor and then the inheritance distributed.We say u already got compensated by not paying rent.She does not agree.Younger sisters are suffering.Pls advise. 1532 views Q. Who will be the legal heirs of a mentally ill sister? 3788 views Q. We have a house of our grandmother. She had 2 sons and 2 daughters 1579 views Q. Assalaamu 'alaikkum respected teachers, This question is of utmost importance to a family here in INDIA at this time. Let me explain. A man Abdul Wahab had 4 children, 1 son named Idris and 3 daughters. He has a common property. Abdul Wahab and his wife passes away. NOW THE PROPERTY DOCUMENT IS NOT TRANSFERRED TO THE 4 CHILDREN. THE PROPERTY IS STILL IN ABDUL WAHAB's NAME. Son Idris looks after the affairs of this property. Now the son Idris also passes away. Idris has 5 sons, 4 daughters and 1 Wife. So now when the legal heirs of Abdul Wahab wanted to divide the property, the 3 daughters of Abdul Wahab take One share each and leave 2 shares to rest with the deceased Idris family. Now my question is, a. what is the ratio at which Idris share is partitioned among his wife and Children ? b. Who are the legal heirs of Idris ? c. If Idris's wife has a share ? As the property in question is not on Idris's name but of his father. Please reply this question as soon as possible as some family members makes an issue whether to give a share to the mother. Please give this question TOP PRIORITY. Assalaamu 'alaikkum, Mubeen. 1988 views Q. Distribution of property 1773 views Q. inheritance of sister 1628 views Q. Property distribution between mother and three son 3146 views Q. A person died leaving back wife, mother and two female children. Please, clear share as per Muslim law. 1854 views Q. irresponsible father 1924 views Q. Property distribution 1914 views
answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Inheritance & Will Question ID: 26449 Country: India Title: I am 45 yrs.My father expired before 25 yrs, at that time I was 20 yrs.We are 3 sons and 6 daughters (iam the last one) we have a property in my fathers name, at that time value was around RS. 1 lac. One of my brother got cash Rs. 1 lac without knowing to any of us after my fathers expiry without legal registration still it is in our fathers name only.He also handed over the property to that person. After 25 yrs we all, excluding one of my brother who got cash, joined together and tried to vacate the person who is there. at that time he said he has given the amount for this property to one of my brother. After that my brother who got the cash also agreed and to leave his share to that person who is there. The person who gave cash also agreed for that condition. today this property value is around 1.25 to 1.75 crores. The main problem is moulana, The person who gave cash said that he went to one of my sister's husband, he sent that person to me. But I don't remember whether he has come to my place or not.But he is telling the marks of my place correctly. also he said that, I had said that to him don't worry pls go, my brother will finish off your problem and do you the favour. But I don't remember whether I had said or not. Due to this problem, whether this property is halal or haram for me? Question: Assalamu Alaikkum, Moulana saheb, Iam 45 yrs.My father expired before 25 yrs, at that time I was 20 yrs.We are 3 sons and 6 daughters (iam the last one) we have a property in my fathers name, at that time value was around RS. 1 lac. One of my brother got cash Rs. 1 lac without knowing to any of us after my fathers expiry without legal registration still it is in our fathers name only.He also handed over the property to that person. After 25 yrs we all, excluding one of my brother who got cash, joined together and tried to vacate the person who is there. at that time he said he has given the amount for this property to one of my brother. After that my brother who got the cash also agreed and to leave his share to that person who is there. The person who gave cash also agreed for that condition. today this property value is around 1.25 to 1.75 crores. The main problem is moulana, The person who gave cash said that he went to one of my sister's husband, he sent that person to me. But I don't remember whether he has come to my place or not.But he is telling the marks of my place correctly. also he said that, I had said that to him don't worry pls go, my brother will finish off your problem and do you the favour. But I don't remember whether I had said or not. Due to this problem, whether this property is halal or haram for me? Answer ID: 26449 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1762/D=401/k=1431) Your brother sold his share in the property to a person for one lakh. He admits the same and that person too accepts the same. In this case, the property equal to your brother's share became his property and in the rest of the property the remaining two brothers and three sisters and the mother as well, if she is alive, shall get their shares. Hence, it is lawful for you to take your share in the property without any doubt. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
